theory: A readable mathematical artifact owes checkable connections to formal statements, assumptions, and provenance. Completion obligations are computed from workspace and document evidence, while compilation establishes only that particular source produced a readable PDF. Informal review and formal proof retain separate meanings.
instead_of: A PDF generator would consider compiler success sufficient; this code treats labels, exact quoted statements, assumption disclosure, and honest status stamping as part of an accountable artifact.

absorption.rationale: New obligations and literal environments fit, but establishing visibility through arbitrary TeX macros and conditionals requires engine-level observation beyond the current scanner.

world_mapping.rationale: Compiler-created labels, exact statements, obligations, and separate status enums have meanings a reader can inspect; empty obligations explicitly do not certify mathematics.

abstraction.rationale: Pure completion functions return obligations from mappings, separately from compiler processes and publication. Status contracts avoid collapsing proof and document outcomes.

justification.rationale: Code explains excluded verbatim-like environments, saved versus owing theorems, and why missing glyphs invalidate compilation. Stamp tests distinguish author source from compiled provenance.

honest_limits.rationale: The scanner states its restricted conditionals; compilation rejects interrupted/overflowed output, and failed source is re-rendered with its earned status.

rehearsals.requirement: Require another mechanically checkable disclosure before completion.
rehearsals.why: Add an obligation to the pure outstanding computation; callers already consume obligations instead of a model assertion.

rehearsals.requirement: Accept another TeX environment preserving every Lean character literally.
rehearsals.why: Extend the supported environment set once preservation is established; the quotation check remains shared.

rehearsals.requirement: Recognize claim visibility after arbitrary TeX macros and conditionals execute.
rehearsals.why: General visibility needs compiler instrumentation or a new representation, rather than additional special cases in a bounded string scanner.
